cards.title: The ellipse fit's radius reads high, as py4DSTEM's does: close it with a note, or measure more
context: macTEM found that the detector-ellipse fit (the Conic model, a port of py4DSTEM fit_ellipse_1D) puts a ring's radius slightly outside its peak, by 1.75 (s/R)², s the ring's width and R its radius. Measured here on clean rings: +0.25 % at R 80 px with s 3 px, +0.04 % at R 200. py4DSTEM has the same objective, so this is a property of the method, not a porting error.

Nothing in this app uses the radius itself: the correction applies only b/a and the angle. On a ring whose width grows with its radius b/a came out exact; on a constant-width ring it under-reads the distortion by 3.5 (s/R)² of itself (0.5 % of a 3 % distortion at s/R 0.04). The a and b in the status line and Prepare are py4DSTEM's semi-axes, not a calibrated ring radius; the manual-entry help already says only b/a and the angle are applied.

The Fit button prefers the profile model (an asymmetric Gaussian with a background term). On 84 clean test rings it kept the profile on 59 and fell back to the conic on 25, mostly rings with a missing arc.

Not measured: how a background under the ring moves the conic's numbers. A scratch model of the objective suggests background moves the radius more than the ring width does, and could under-read the distortion on the fallback path. Knowing needs its own registration and measurement.
A note with the formula is now on the function; it is true whichever option you pick. The stop-rule bug macTEM found in the same function is fixed separately.

glossary.meaning: the Fit button's second choice, used when the profile model does not fit well enough.

cards.question: Close this with the note, or also measure the background effect on the fallback?

options.label: Close it with the note
options.what: Nothing else changes. macTEM is told to calibrate a camera length with the profile fit and to measure its own rings.
options.risk: none known for this app's numbers; the background question stays open

options.label: The note, plus a measurement
options.what: Register and run a Gate D measurement: background and annulus width through tools/ellipse-calibration-test, and how often your own cubes land on the conic fallback. No code change unless it finds a defect.

options.label: The note, plus an unbiased radius here
options.what: A separately named radius estimator in this app's Core, for calibrating a camera length from a ring.
options.risk: new code in a frozen theme (ADR 052) that only macTEM would call

cards.recommendWhy: No number this app applies depends on the radius. If you want the background question answered, b is cheap; c belongs in macTEM's own plan.
cards.advisor: An independent second opinion (Sonnet 5.5, read-only) agrees with a: an estimator here is blocked by ADR 052 (calibration stays frozen) and would be dead code in this app, and macTEM's route is the profile fit, refusing a fallback. It flagged the background effect as unmeasured and worth its own registration (b), and asked that 1.75 (s/R)² be called a floor, not a correction (done).
